messages:
maria: Quick check — we need final social copy + posting cadence for next Tue launch (benchmark + webinar reminder). Who can take X vs LinkedIn?
aj: I can own X (threads + 1-pager thread). Will draft 6 tweets: 1 teaser, 3 benefit bullets, 1 metric highlight, 1 CTA. ETA EOD today.
rachel: I’ll do LinkedIn long-form + 3 carousel cards. Will stitch a short case stat from the benchmark.
devon: tagging in assets — @design uploaded the carousel mockups to the launch drive: https://drive.redwood/example (see /social/bench-webinar).
maria: nice. For X thread: 1) benchmark headline 2) why it matters 3) short technical note 4) link to full report 5) webinar CTA 6) register link. Keep the technical note one sentence.
aj: noted. Also want to A/B CTA copy — "Register for the demo" vs "See the numbers live". Which should we test?
sam: test the second CTA on paid boost. organic gets first CTA.
rachel: LinkedIn carousel slide order: 1 summary, 2 graph highlight, 3 cost/latency takeaway, 4 CTA/register. I'll write alt text for accessibility.
devon: small ask — can we get the PNG of the latency graph at 1200x628 for X link preview? design said they’ll export.
maria: @marketing-bot can you schedule the threads? We want X thread Tue 10:00 PT, LinkedIn 10:15 PT, follow-up post Thu 11:00 PT.
marketing-bot: Scheduling request received: queue created for 2026-03-24T17:00Z (X), 2026-03-24T17:15Z (LinkedIn). Reminder set for 24h before.
aj: quick copy draft (X thread):
```
aj: 1/6 🚀 New benchmark: open models vs quantized variants on throughput + cost. Short version: 2–3x speedups at 1.2x cost.
2/6 Why it matters: infra choices change unit economics for chat apps.
3/6 Tech detail: continuous batching + KV cache wins for long-tail prompts.
4/6 Result highlight: 250ms median latency on 8k context.
5/6 Read the full report + charts: https://redwood.ai/bench24
6/6 Join our webinar Thurs — live walkthrough and Q&A → register: https://redwood.ai/webinar-signup
```
aj: comments welcome, this is intentionally punchy.
rachel: For LinkedIn first paragraph I want: one-line hook, then 3 bullets (impact/cost/where to apply), then CTA. I'll post the draft here in ~2h.
maria: SDR routing — we should tag hot leads from webinar signups into the 'benchmark-interested' queue. @sdr-team can you confirm your preferred fields from the form? (company, ARR band, infra question checkbox)
sdr-team: confirmed. Please include 'current inference provider' + 'priority use case' + 'email' + 'company size'. We'll pull and triage within 24h.
aj: engagement plan for X: pin the thread, reply to first 20 meaningful replies within 1 hour, + retweet 3 insightful comments. Use templated reply for basic Qs: "Thanks! Here's the short answer: ... Want us to send the full report?"
maria: good. For LinkedIn comments, devon — can you prepare 4 canned responses for common asks (pricing, dedicated vs hosted, private deploy)? Keep them 1-2 lines each.
devon: will do. Also suggest we coordinate with eng on one clarifying quote about quantization tradeoffs. Tagging @eng-ml separately.
aj: small formatting note for X thread: keep each tweet <240 chars, and include emoji on 1 and 6 only.
rachel: also plan an image alt for each carousel card and include a 1-line caption for the asset.
sam: I'll run a small paid test day-of: $200 to the teaser tweet with CTA B. Report back after 8 hours.
maria: blockers?
aj: only missing high-res latency graph.
devon: design said done by 3pm PT.
maria: ok let's reconvene if anything slips. Final owners: aj (X copy + thread scheduling), rachel (LinkedIn copy + carousel), devon (assets + eng liaison), sdr-team (lead routing). I'll post a follow-up checklist tomorrow. :thumbsup:
aj: got it.
rachel: got it.
sdr-team: thanks — we'll prep routing rules.
marketing-bot: Posting queue confirmed. Reminder: cross-post rules enabled (no auto-linkedin for threads).
maria: thanks everyone, closing this thread.
